nodes.label: Task K2 Report — preamble+FMI parsed incrementally, _skipMeta option added to fromPart10 (commits 06e2ca3+9930864)
Incremental preamble + File Meta Information parsing with buffered startDataSet replay
nodes.rationale: FMI is always explicit-LE and never deflated (PS3.5 §7.1), so it can be header-decoded incrementally from the chunk stream. FMI element events must be buffered until (0002,0010) is decoded because startDataSet must carry the correct transferSyntaxUID — there is no listener contract for correcting it later. Values are copied into fresh ArrayBuffers (FMI is <1KB) to respect D-E aliasing rules. Header framing uses ValueRepresentation.isLength32() for parity by construction rather than a hardcoded extended-VR set.
